input.command:
python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

# Let's inspect obs_0018
img18 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0018.png')
# obs_0018 pose: x=0.1830, y=1.1830, heading=60.0 deg
# Find cabinet bounding box in obs_0018
# It has two wood panels and a white side/top
# Let's find rows 250 to 450, cols 100 to 250
print('obs_0018: cabinet region')
mask18 = (img18[:, :, 0] > 100) & (img18[:, :, 0] < 160) & (img18[:, :, 1] > 140) & (img18[:, :, 1] < 190) & (img18[:, :, 2] > 170) & (img18[:, :, 2] < 220)
ys, xs = np.where(mask18)
print(f'obs_0018 wood panels: x=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], y=[{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}]')

# Find white panel in obs_0018
mask18_white = (img18[:, :, 0] > 230) & (img18[:, :, 1] > 230) & (img18[:, :, 2] > 230)
# exclude ceiling / walls: y in [280, 450], x in [100, 200]
sub_white = mask18_white[280:450, 100:200]
ys_w, xs_w = np.where(sub_white)
print(f'obs_0018 white face: x=[{xs_w.min()+100}, {xs_w.max()+100}], y=[{ys_w.min()+280}, {ys_w.max()+280}]')
"
